image.title: Koeln 1945
image.alt: The Kölner Dom (Cologne Cathedral) stands seemingly undamaged (although having been directly hit several times and damaged severely) while entire area surrounding it is completely devastated. The central railway station and Hohenzollern Bridge lie damaged to the north and east of the cathedral. Germany, 24 April 1945.
image.creator: U.S. Department of Defense. Department of the Army. Office of the Chief Signal Officer. [2]
